title: Minimum Cost to Cut a Board
problemStatement: A rectangular board must be cut into 1 × 1 squares. Each horizontal and vertical cut has an associated cost. Determine the minimum total cost required to cut the entire board.
input: • First line contains integers R and C. • Second line contains R−1 integers representing horizontal cut costs. • Third line contains C−1 integers representing vertical cut costs.
output: Print the minimum total cutting cost.
